exercises.title: A study group invitation
exercises.instructions: Arrange every phrase once to form a grammatical sentence.

exercises.title: Request a quieter study room
exercises.instructions: Write an email to the campus study-room coordinator.
exercises.prompt: Your group has reserved a room beside a busy rehearsal studio. Explain the problem, request a quieter room for Thursday afternoon, and offer an alternative time if no room is available. Do not include real personal details.

exercises.title: Choosing a campus sustainability project
exercises.instructions: Contribute your opinion and support it with reasons. Engage with the discussion.
exercises.prompt: Professor Lee: Our campus can fund either a repair workshop or additional recycling bins. Which should receive funding first, and why?

contributions.name: Maya
contributions.text: A repair workshop could extend the life of items and help students learn practical skills.

contributions.name: Owen
contributions.text: Recycling bins would be available to more people every day, so their impact might be broader.
